sql: SELECT COUNT(*) unreviewed_goal_panels,SUM(CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM self_improvements s WHERE s.panel_id=p.id AND s.approved_by LIKE '%oracle-lane%') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) with_oracle_lane_approver FROM specialist_panels p WHERE p.status='goal_created' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM specialist_reviews r WHERE r.panel_id=p.id)
